description: This Java source file defines the utility class ConnectionLogUtil, which provides methods for adding connection and correlation identifiers to logging contexts, specifically integrating with SLF4J MDC and DiagnosticLoggingAdapter. It is part of a connectivity utilities package within the Eclipse Ditto project, aiding in structured and contextual logging for connection-related operations.

classes.name: ConnectionLogUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to enhance logging with connection and correlation IDs in different logging contexts (MDC and DiagnosticLoggingAdapter).

methods.name: enhanceLogWithConnectionId
methods.description: Adds a connection ID to the MDC or logging adapter for contextual logging.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationIdAndConnectionId
methods.description: Adds both correlation ID and connection ID to the logs for better traceability, either in MDC or in a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter.

methods.name: removeConnectionId
methods.description: Removes the connection ID entry from the MDC of a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter.
